children: Teva completed a multi-currency, multi-tranche senior unsecured notes offering totaling $3.2 billion and €1.5 billion to refinance debt and enhance financial flexibility. The five series include €1.0 billion 4.250% notes due 2033 and €500 million 4.625% notes due 2036 issued by Teva Pharmaceutical Finance Netherlands II, $1.2 billion 5.250% notes due 2032 issued by Teva Pharmaceutical Finance Netherlands IV, and $1.0 billion each of 5.500% notes due 2034 and 5.750% notes due 2037 issued by Teva Pharmaceutical Finance Netherlands III. All notes are guaranteed by Teva and issued under senior indentures with Bank of New York Mellon as trustee. Proceeds will fund conditional redemptions of select higher-coupon notes, pay related fees and expenses, and support general corporate purposes.
